off_resonance.susceptibility_rule: For fixed anatomy, orientation and shim assumptions, scale an existing susceptibility field in Hz by B0/reference_B0; ppm remains fixed. Actual scanner shim fields are not guaranteed to scale this way.
off_resonance.multi_peak_caveat: Hamilton Table 3 six liver-fat peaks are at absolute ppm [5.3,4.2,2.75,2.1,1.3,0.9] relative to water4.7, fractions [.047,.039,.006,.120,.700,.088]. These are liver-fat spectral weights, not measured epicardial-fat weights. A one-peak fat model must be explicitly labelled as such.

caveats: Means are deliberately selected from measurements; no interpolation or assumed monotonic T2 scaling.
Different sequence methods and cohorts introduce bias; these fixed values are simulation conventions.
Blood properties depend strongly on oxygenation and hematocrit; same canonical compartment is currently assigned to both chamber labels unless an arterial/venous model is separately introduced.
Fat measurements are subcutaneous/body-fat proxies rather than directly measured epicardial fat.
Do not multiply T2 by field-strength ratio or model T2* by reducing T2 when static B0 is explicitly simulated.
Original supplied 3 T asset bytes should remain immutable; derived field-specific assets must have their own hashes/provenance.
